brightport_elysa.m: But as you know very well, the Guild has it's rules, we're not keen on doing charity. Luckily we have just the right errand for you.
r: I don't feel like working for you right now.

brightport_elysa0.m: First you must know more about our activities and how the Guild operates in Brightport.
r: I don't have time, can't we get on with it already?

brightport_elysa1.m: For most of the time since its existence, the Guild in Brightport was a place to train new recruits, away from the soldiers of Feygard and the more established thieves of Nor City.

brightport_elysa11.m: Is that so? I believe you'll change your mind.

brightport_elysa12.m: Just a little errand for the Guild, I believe you are well acquainted with those.

brightport_elysa13.m: Very good work, $playername. I heard the guards went on patrol while you were there, and you skillfully avoided them. The Guild would very much like to have your skills again in the future.

brightport_elysa14.m: And now the information I promised. Your brother Andor came here and asked a few questions.

brightport_elysa15.m: That is all I feel inclined to share.

brightport_elysa16.m: Sigh. I thought we'd be safe away from the town. My mood is soured. I'll still tell you about Andor, but only for some gold.

brightport_elysa2.m: Fine, $playername. I'll skip the details then.

brightport_elysa3.m: We need you to pick up a package from the mediator of one of our clients. We've received word that he'll be waiting in the old building east of town. Be discreet, and make sure the guards don't see you.
r: I'll pick up that package for you.

brightport_elysa4.m: But with Remgard's increasing exports of quality steel over the past hundred years, our guildhall was expanded to accomodate the growing demand for weapon smuggling.

brightport_elysa5.m: With the restrictions on the trade of weapons and steel by Feygard, our importance has only increased. However, the newly established inspections have made carrying out our activities in town a nuisance. Several of my men have already been captured and sent to Feygard's prison.

brightport_elysa6.m: Have you been the to the meeting place yet?
r: The courier was not there. Apparently he got arrested.

brightport_elysa7.m: Good, well then where is the package?
r: Sorry I think I dropped it somewhere.
It's lost, and I can't find it.

brightport_elysa8.m: Elysa opens the small box, glances at the item inside, and closes it again.

brightport_elysa9.m: What incompetence! go pick it up.

brightport_elysa_andor.m: Yes, because YOU, were rude enough to leave in the middle of our conversation. You have no patience, and you should feel ashamed.
r: I'm sorry, please tell me about Andor.

brightport_elysa_caught.m: $playername, you're all covered in grime, how did it go.
r: The guards came in after I got it from the agent. I tried hiding, but they found me and took the package with them.
The guards came in after I got it from the agent. I tried hiding, but they found me. They left me the package but they took what was inside with them.

brightport_elysa_caught1.m: And they haven't arrested you, at least that's good. Have they opened the package to see what's inside?

brightport_elysa_caught2.m: They will never be able to tell that it was a code. We will simply have to ask the client directly for any additional details.

brightport_elysa_caught3.m: And now, let's talk about you, $playername. I'm a bit disheartened that you got caught, but I'm still willing to tell you what I know of your brother. I was planning on telling you in the first place, but a good opportunity didn't arise.

brightport_elysa_caught4.m: First, as Umar told you, Andor was looking for directions to the potion maker named Lodar; and second, he wanted information.

brightport_elysa_caught5.m: He wanted to know who our members are and what skills they possess. Lastly, he asked for a map of Feygard's sewers, and more importantly, the area directly under the palace. I shared this information with your brother, as his little adventure greatly benefits the Guild.

brightport_elysa_caught_alt.m: And they haven't arrested you. That's good. Have they examined the contents of the package?

brightport_elysa_common.m: Hello $playername, I don't have any work to give you.
r: You haven't told me about Andor.
Can you tell me about Andor again?

brightport_elysa_failsafe.m: You lost it? Sigh. I had higher expectations of you, my mood is soured. I'll still tell you about Andor, but only for some gold.

brightport_elysa_greeting.m: Hello, $playername. Here to work for us? If so we still have that errand for you.
r: I don't feel like working for you right now.

brightport_elysa_jail.m: You don't have to tell me, I know $playername, you got caught and they took the package. We don't have much left to discuss. I will still tell you about your brother Andor, but not for free.
r: I actually have the package here!

brightport_elysa_jail0.m: You've pleasantly surprised me $playername! I didn't think you would get to keep it after your failure.
r: Here you go. [Give her the package.]

brightport_elysa_jail1.m: Your work was supposed to pay for it, however now I feel inclined to put a price on it. {1000} gold.
r: I don't have the gold now. I will come later.

brightport_elysa_jail2.m: Elysa takes the package, opens it and takes a long look at you.

brightport_elysa_jail3.m: Have you come to make a fool of yourself $playername? The package is empty.

brightport_elysa_package.m: $playername, you're all covered in grime, how did it go.

brightport_thiefboss_introduction0.m: A familiar face, but you're not exactly the one I remember. Pleased to meet you, $playername.
r: I heard my brother Andor came to speak with you before. I was hoping you could tell me about your meeting with him.

brightport_thiefboss_introduction1.m: Well well, if it isn't one of Umar's little helpers. Did Umar run out of work for you already?
r: I heard my brother Andor came to speak with you before. I was hoping you could tell me about your meeting with him.

brightport_thiefboss_introduction2.m: I was expecting your visit after receiving a letter from Fallhaven. Umar wrote that you would come and ask some questions.

brightport_thiefboss_introduction3.m: I don't know anything more than what Umar has told you. However there is a single detail about your brother that might help you.
r: A detail about my brother? I'm all ears.
My journey in search of him is over, but I wouldn't mind hearing something new.

Thieves03.1: Time to rest and prepare myself to start the next job. I should go to the tavern.
Thieves03.2: I really need to take a break ....
Thieves03.3: I am now fully rested, so I should go back to Umar.
Thieves03.4: Umar told me about a group of traitors led by a veteran of the Guild. It seems he stole the Key of Luthor.
Thieves03.5: Umar went on to say that this team leader  was known as "Crackshot". He is probably also the responsible for a murder on the Duleian road.
Thieves03.10: Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding somewhere near the Duleian road. I must ask people there whether they have seen them.
Thieves03.11: It seems that Benbyr, a suspicious man outside Crossroads Guardhouse, doesn't know what I'm talking about.
Thieves03.15: A Crossroads guard told me that Feygard has sent more soldiers to the south, to try and find the criminals' hideout.
Thieves03.20: The barricade guard has a big mouth, and told me all I needed to know. The hideout is near a place full of larval burrowers. I need to move faster than the patrols to reach the hideout before them.
Thieves03.21: I found a small hole which seems to lead to a cave. Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding there.
Thieves03.22: I reached the hideout and saw some recent blood stains. Maybe there was a fight there.
Thieves03.24: I heard screams and sword clashes nearby. I should take a look.
Thieves03.25: There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.26: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found another dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.27: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found a dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.28: I found another dying soldier. There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.30: I've found the patrol sergeant. He advised me to leave this dangerous place.
Thieves03.31: The patrol sergeant told me about what happened before. He's tired and wounded, so I willl avenge his fellows.
Thieves03.32: The patrol sergeant has left to call for backup. Now I'm alone again. Time to defeat Crackshot.
Thieves03.35: I killed Crackshot and he had the key of Luthor with him. I have to go back and report to Umar.
Thieves03.36: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I cannot get the key into the lock.
Thieves03.40: The dying Crackshot said something about the key. If he told the truth, it could be cursed.
Thieves03.41: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I could not get the key turned in the lock.
Thieves03.45: I reported about the situation to Umar, and gave him the key. He did not seem to want to tell me more about the key - yet.
Thieves03.50: Finally, this job is done. Now I should take a rest and regain my strength.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

andor_ending.1: Giving up the quest to be a hero or villain
andor_ending.900: Search for andor ended, used to supress questions related to the search like "have you seen my brother andor"

brightport_thieves.10: The Thieves Guild was due to receive a package, but the guards in Brightport have been impeding their activities. They need a new face like me to pick the package up discretly. I was told to head east of the town.
brightport_thieves.20: I met the courier from Nor City inside the house.
brightport_thieves.30: Before we could conclude the meeting we heard the town guard making noise outside.
brightport_thieves.35: Thanks to some previous interactions I've had with the commander, I convinced the guards to let me go.
brightport_thieves.40: I couldn't fool the guards and got caught.
brightport_thieves.45: I managed to hide inside a crate and waited. Eventually, the guards left.
brightport_thieves.50: I delivered the package to Elysa, She was pleased with my work and said the Thieves Guild may have further opportunities for me in the future.
brightport_thieves.60: I lied to Gunfryk in a plot to kill him, and in the process the courier I was supposed to meet got arrested.
brightport_thieves.70: I failed to deliver the package to Elysa. She was not happy.
